name: Ramp Bot
tagline: Pairs Gmail with Ramp corporate cards so missing receipts stop locking them
description: Connects a Gmail inbox to a Ramp corporate-card account and works through them daily, matching receipt emails to the charges they belong to and adding any memos that are missing. The point is continuity: teams whose card program suspends plastic over unattached paperwork stop losing access mid-week.
author: matthewbarge
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
